text: {"lessons":["I rarely check or trade, so I should avoid reacting to short-term account swings and review my holdings deliberately.","Selling some of Stocks B and E after strong gains felt satisfying, but I should base future decisions on their prospects and portfolio balance, not just on locking in gains.","Losses bother me more than equivalent gains please me, so I should recognize that bias and assess risk and diversification objectively."]}
